title: NIST WebBook: Nitric oxide is NO, molecular weight 30.0061 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Nitric oxide as NO, molecular weight 30.0061 amu, CAS 10102-43-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Nitric oxide, CAS Registry Number 10102-43-9, lists molecular formula NO and molecular weight 30.0061 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 29.9979886244 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/NO/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
